messages:
Lina Gomez: Heads-up: VectorChip EAP (VectorChip-V2) kickoff. NDA signed last night. Partner wants a short preview listing + joint blog post after validation. Need bench matrix, telemetry plan, and embargo window nailed down by Fri.
Tom Bragg: Nice. Can we get their OS images and firmware by Wed? I want to run compatibility tests against `rc/vector-v2`.
Samira Chen: Will plan a minimal harness: correctness -> warm throughput -> sustained QPS -> tail-latency. Proposed perf gates for preview: rwd-13b p50<65ms p95<260ms @8k; rwd-70b p50<160ms p95<480ms @8k.
Legal Bot: NDA status: signed. Redlines cleared except partner requested a 30-day embargo extension clause. Please confirm announce timing.
Lina Gomez: Partner requested "internal soft mention" after bench artifacts uploaded and public co-announce 7 days after GA. Suggest we keep provisional dates until bench finishes.
Infra Lab: Reserved bench slots: Thu 01:00-04:00 UTC and Fri 18:00-22:00 UTC. Upload configs to https://drive.redwood/apps/vectorchip/eap-configs.
Tom Bragg: Command (dev harness): `./ci/bench --target vector-v2 --model rwd-13b --ctx 8192 --mode fp16 --warmup 600 --samples 150 --cold-start`
Samira Chen: Telemetry plan: 0.5% token sampling, prefix cache hit/miss, cold-start traces. We'll strip prompt text before export. Legal Bot: telemetry plan OK (no PII).
Lina Gomez: Marketplace Team: can you prepare a preview listing that uses "preview" language and partner badge? Avoid GA claims.
Tom Bragg: Runtime fallback: add `vector-v2-quant` as memory-pressure path. Snippet for runtime config: `{"fallback":"vector-quant","metrics_group":"vector-eap"}`
deploy-bot: bench job queued: job_id=VC-EAP-2207, eta Thu 01:00 UTC. Logs: /runs/VC-EAP-2207
Samira Chen: I'll run harness in Thu slot and upload artifacts to /runs/VC-EAP-2207/artifacts (logs, flamegraphs, heatmaps).
Lina Gomez: Action items: Samira run benches + upload (Due: Fri EOD), Tom verify images + runtime fallback (Due: Thu), Marketplace prepare listing draft (Due: Fri). Quick sync Thu 09:30 PT to confirm. :rocket:
